title: Shenzhen, Guangdong — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Shenzhen, Guangdong: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Shenzhen is a city in Guangdong with a population of 17,560,000. China’s tech innovation hub and Silicon Valley equivalent, home to Huawei and Tencent, with a subtropical climate and modern urban planning. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
